topic: Getting Free Tax Help at the Community Center

script.title: FREE TAX HELP DAY
script.scene_zh: 社區中心 · 志工報稅
script.story_hook: New job, first tax return, friendly grandmas.
script.intro_zh: 第一份工作、第一次報稅，還好有拿鉛筆的阿嬤志工。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today we're at a free tax help desk. Listen for words about money and forms.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天的場景在社區中心的免費報稅桌。留意表格與金錢相關的說法。
script.outro: And the return is done. Listen again and try it out loud.
script.outro_zh: 申報表順利完成了。再聽一次，大聲跟著說說看。
script.practice_intro_en: Now let's repeat each line together.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在我們一起逐句跟讀。
script.char_a_description: a hardworking young man in his early thirties with short dark hair in a low fade and a thin trimmed beard, a navy chef's jacket with rolled sleeves, and a small tattoo on one forearm
script.char_b_description: a grandmotherly East Asian woman in her late sixties with silver hair in a soft permed puff, round tortoiseshell glasses, a plum quilted vest over a cream turtleneck, and a pencil behind her ear

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, is this the free tax help table?
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɪz ðɪs ðə fri tæks hɛl ˈteɪbəl/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，這裡是免費報稅諮詢的桌子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is, have a seat! First visit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz hæv ə sit fɝst ˈvɪzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，請坐！第一次來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: First, yes. Marco Santos. I started last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɝst jɛz ˈmɑɹkoʊ ˈsɑntoʊz aɪ stɑɹtəd læst wik/
dialogue.zh: 第一次。馬可·桑托斯。我上週剛開始工作。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome, Marco. I'm Han, volunteer number nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm ˈmɑɹkoʊ aɪm hæn ˌvɑlənˈtɪɹ ˈnʌmbɚ naɪn/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎你，馬可。我是韓阿姨，九號志工。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Volunteer, so this really is free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌvɑlənˈtɪɹ soʊ ðɪs ˈɹɛli ɪz fri/
dialogue.zh: 志工？所以這真的不收費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Truly free, the city pays us, not you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtɹuli fri ðə ˈsɪti peɪz ʌs nɑt ju/
dialogue.zh: 真的免費，市公所付我們費用，不收你的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow. My coworker said you'd charge, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ maɪ ˈkoˌwɝkɚ sɛd jud tʃɑɹdʒ hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 哇。我同事還以為要收錢，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We wish, ha! Okay, what did you bring?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi wɪʃ hɑ oʊˈkeɪ wət dɪd ju brɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我們還巴不得收呢，哈！好，你帶來了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, my W2, my ID, and... is that all?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm maɪ ˈdʌbəlju tu maɪ aɪˈdi ænd ɪz ðæt ɔl/
dialogue.zh: 呃，我的 W2、我的身分證，還有……就這樣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Close! We also need the bank routing slip.
dialogue.phonetic: /kloʊs wi ˈɔlsoʊ nid ðə bæŋk ˈɹaʊtɪŋ slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 差一點！我們還需要銀行的存款資訊單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh right, a blank check, you mean?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ˈɹaɪt ə blæŋk ˈtʃɛk ju ˈmin/
dialogue.zh: 噢，對，是一張空白支票嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, that's for the refund deposit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðæts fɚ ðə ɹɪˈfʌnd dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，那是用來填退款匯入的帳戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is? I expected cash in an envelope.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz aɪ ɪkˈspɛktəd kæʃ ɪn ən ˈɛnvəˌloʊp/
dialogue.zh: 是嗎？我以為會拿到信封裝的現金。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Direct deposit lands in five days, no risk.
dialogue.phonetic: /dəˈɹɛkt dɪˈpɑzɪt lændz ɪn faɪv deɪz noʊ rɪsk/
dialogue.zh: 直接存款五天就到帳，沒有風險。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Five days... well, that's honestly pretty fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv deɪz wɛl ðæts ˈɑnəstli ˈpɹɪti fæst/
dialogue.zh: 五天……這老實說挺快的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper checks take weeks and sometimes hide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpɚ tʃɛks teɪk wiks ænd ˈsʌmˌtaɪmz haɪd/
dialogue.zh: 紙本支票要好幾週，有時還會躲起來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, mine once lived in a jacket pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ maɪn wʌns lɪvd ɪn ə ˈdʒækɪt ˈpɑkɪt/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我那張曾在一個外套口袋裡住了整個季節。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Classic. Do I file alone, or with someone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklæsɪk du aɪ faɪl əˈloʊn ɔɹ wɪð ˈsʌmˌwʌn/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事。我一個人報，還是跟人一起報？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Alone, I think. Is that many forms?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈloʊn aɪ θɪŋk ɪz ðæt ˈmɛni fɔɹmz/
dialogue.zh: 我想是單獨。表格會很多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just two: federal first, then the state one.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tu ˈfɛdɹəl fɝst ðɛn ðə steɪt wʌn/
dialogue.zh: 只有兩張：先聯邦稅，再州稅那張。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two sounds doable. What do I sign?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu saʊndz ˈduəbəl wət du aɪ saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 兩張聽起來可行。我要簽哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Uh, actually I'll fill it, you just read and sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌ ˈæktʃuəli aɪl fɪl ɪt ju dʒʌst ɹid ænd saɪn/
dialogue.zh: 呃，其實是我來填，你只要讀懂再簽名。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please, you're the boss of the pen.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz jʊɹ ðə ˈbɑs əv ðə ˈpɛn/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你才是這支筆的老闆。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! One question: did you live here all year?
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wʌn ˈkwɛstʃən dɪd ju lɪv hɪɹ ɔl jɪɹ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！先問一下：你整年都住這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost. I moved from Texas in April.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlmoʊst aɪ muvd fɹəm ˈtɛksəs ɪn ˈeɪpɹəl/
dialogue.zh: 差不多。我四月才從德州搬來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we mark two states, no big deal.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi ˈmɑɹk tu steɪts noʊ ˈbɪɡ ˈdil/
dialogue.zh: 那我們就標兩個州，不是大問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay. Can I ask something in Chinese?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ kæn aɪ æsk ˈsʌmθɪŋ ɪn tʃaɪˈniz/
dialogue.zh: 好。我可以用中文問問題嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course! My Mandarin is rusty, but yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔɹs maɪ ˈmændəɹn ɪz ˈɹʌsti bət jɛz/
dialogue.zh: 當然！我的華語有點生疏，但可以。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Amazing! Mom asks: does her refund go to Dad?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈmeɪzɪŋ mæm æskəz dʌz hɚ ˈɹɪˌfʌnd ɡoʊ tə dæd/
dialogue.zh: 太厲害了！我媽媽問：她的退款會進我爸的戶頭嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only if they file together, which is smart.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ɪf ðeɹ faɪl təˈɡɛðɚ wɪtʃ ɪz smɑɹt/
dialogue.zh: 只有共同報稅才會，那其實是聰明做法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, they're shy about paperwork, honestly.
dialogue.phonetic: /həm ðeɹ ʃaɪ əˈbaʊt ˈpeɪpɚˌwɝk ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，他們倆一碰文件就害羞，說真的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bring them next Saturday, I'll go slow.
dialogue.phonetic: /bɹɪŋ ðɛm nɛkst ˈsæɾɚˌdeɪ aɪl ɡoʊ sloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 下週六把他們帶來，我會慢慢說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They'd love that. Um, my W2 looks strange.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛd lʌv ðæt ʌm maɪ ˈdʌbəlju tu lʊks stɹeɪndʒ/
dialogue.zh: 他們會很開心的。呃，我的 W2 看起來怪怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How strange? Show me, I've seen stranger.
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈstɹeɪndʒ ʃoʊ mi aɪv sin ˈstɹeɪndʒɚ/
dialogue.zh: 有多怪？給我看看，我見過更怪的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The address is my old apartment, wrong now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði əˈdɛs ɪz maɪ oʊld əˈpɑɹtmənt ɹɔŋ naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫的是我舊公寓的地址，已經不對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Common! We fix it right on the form.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɑmən wi fɪks ɪt ɹaɪt ɑn ðə fɔɹm/
dialogue.zh: 常有的事！我們直接在表格上改好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh thank goodness, I feared an audit.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ θæŋk ˈɡʊdnəs aɪ ˈfɪɹd ən ˈɔˌdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 噢，感謝上天，我本來很怕稅務查核。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, nobody here bites. We're grandmas with pencils.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ˈnoʊˌbɑdi hɪɹ baɪts wɪɹ ˈɡɹæməz wɪð ˈpɛnsəlz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，這裡沒人會咬人。我們是拿鉛筆的阿嬤們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Grandmas with pencils. That's my new motto.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɡɹæməz wɪð ˈpɛnsəlz ðæts maɪ nju ˈmɑɾoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 拿鉛筆的阿嬤們。這將成為我的新座右銘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mine too! So, the refund estimate says... hmm.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪn tu soʊ ðə ˈɹɪˌfʌnd ˈɛstəˌmeɪt sɛz həm/
dialogue.zh: 我也是！那麼，退款預估寫著……嗯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is it bad? You said hmm, uh oh.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ɪt bæd ju sɛd həm ˌʌˈoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 是壞消息嗎？你一說嗯，就表示不妙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It's good! About eighteen hundred, if it all fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪts ɡʊd əˈbaʊt eɪˈtin ˈhʌndɹɪd ɪf ɪt ɔl fɪts/
dialogue.zh: 是好消息！大概一千八，如果資料都對得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eighteen hundred! Wow, that's almost a month's rent.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪˈtin ˈhʌndɹəd waʊ ðæts ˈɔlmoʊst ə mʌnθs ɹɛnt/
dialogue.zh: 一千八！哇，那幾乎是一個月的房租。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly why we do this. See, no charge!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli waʊ wi du ðɪs si noʊ tʃɑɹdʒ/
dialogue.zh: 這就是我們做這件事的理由。看，完全不收費！

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I pay you somehow? Tips, anything.
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ peɪ ju ˈsʌmˌhaʊ tɪps ˈɛniθɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 我能怎麼回報你們？小費，什麼都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tell your neighbors, that's our payment, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tɛl jɔɹ ˈneɪbɚz ðæts aʊɹ ˈpeɪmənt hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 跟鄰居說一聲，就是給我們最好的報答，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. What happens after I sign today?
dialogue.phonetic: /dil wət ˈhæpənz ˈæftɚ aɪ saɪn təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 成交。今天我簽完名，接下來會怎樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You get a stamped copy, keep it safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju ɡɛt ə stæmpɪd ˈkɑpi kip ɪt seɪf/
dialogue.zh: 你會拿到一份蓋章複本，好好收著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Stamped copy, got it. And the bank slip?
dialogue.phonetic: /stæmpɪd ˈkɑpi ɡɑɾ ɪt ænd ðə bæŋk slɪp/
dialogue.zh: 蓋章複本，記下了。那銀行的資訊單呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We attach it, then text when it's filed.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi əˈtætʃ ɪt ðɛn tɛkst wɛn ɪts faɪld/
dialogue.zh: 我們把它附上去，送件之後傳簡訊通知你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Text, great, phones beat mailboxes these days.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst ɡɹeɪt foʊnz bit ˈmeɪlˌbɑksəz ðiz deɪz/
dialogue.zh: 簡訊太棒了，現在手機勝過信箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every time. Name order check: Santos, Marco?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvɹi taɪm neɪm ˈɔɹdɚ tʃɛk ˈsɑntoʊz ˈmɑɹkoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 每次都是。姓名順序確認：Santos，Marco？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last name Santos. Yes, you got it right.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst neɪm ˈsɑntoʊz jɛz ju ɡɑt ɪt ɹaɪt/
dialogue.zh: 姓是 Santos。對，你完全寫對了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We ask because computers are literal pets.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi æsk bɪˈkɔz kəmˈpjutɚz ɑɹ ˈlɪtɚəl pɛts/
dialogue.zh: 我們會多問一句，因為電腦是很較真的寵物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! You two should be friends, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ju tu ʃʊd bi ˈfɛndz ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 哈！那你們兩個應該會成為朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I'll bring cookies to the negotiation, ha.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ ˈkʊkiz tə ðə nɪˌɡoʊʃiˈeɪʃən hɑ/
dialogue.zh: 我會帶餅乾去跟它們談判，哈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thank you, truly. This feels way less scary now.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju ˈtɹuli ðɪs filz weɪ lɛs ˈskɛɹi naʊ/
dialogue.zh: 真心感謝你。我現在覺得沒那麼可怕了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime, Marco. Saturday, for your mom and dad.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm ˈmɑɹkoʊ ˈsæɾɚˌdeɪ fɚ jɔɹ mɑm ænd dæd/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣，馬可。週六記得帶爸爸媽媽來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I'll bring them, and tea. Promise.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪl brɪŋ ðəm ænd ˈti ˈpɹɑməs/
dialogue.zh: 我會帶他們來，還帶壺茶。說定了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Green tea accepts all tax questions, bye!
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɹin ti əkˈsɛpts ɔl tæks ˈkwɛstʃənz baɪ/
dialogue.zh: 綠茶歡迎一切報稅問題，再見！

script.youtube_title: 【第一次報稅不用慌🧾】「我們是拿鉛筆的阿嬤」👵🎧｜聽完就敢走進免費報稅站💵｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Free Tax Help Center
script.youtube_title_en: "We're Grandmas With Pencils" — Free Tax Help at the Community Center
script.youtube_description:
「我們是拿鉛筆的阿嬤」——剛開始第一份工作，第一次報稅要帶什麼、簽什麼、錢會怎麼回來？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在社區中心週末開放的免費報稅桌。

你會聽到：開場確認帶了 W2 與身分證；用空白支票登記直接存款；退稅金額怎麼預估到一千八；舊地址寫錯時志工怎麼當場修改；還有用中文問問題、帶爸媽週六再來的暖心收尾。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現的是美國人最常掛嘴邊的客套與玩笑：um、well、so、wow、ha。聽完你就會用：is this the free tax help table、direct deposit、stamped copy、no charge。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先學會，腦袋自然就記住。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請訂閱頻道並開啟小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"We're grandmas with pencils" — first job, first tax season, and the forms feel like a maze. This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at a free tax help table in a community center.

You will hear: checking what documents to bring, using a blank check for direct deposit, watching the refund estimate grow to eighteen hundred, fixing an old address right on the form, and asking questions in Chinese when the volunteer speaks it too.

Everything stays in A2-level words with the small talk Americans really use: um, well, so, wow, ha. By the end you'll own phrases like is this the free tax help table, direct deposit, stamped copy, and no charge.

The second half is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish — subscribe for a new scene every day.

📌 影片簡介：
剛開始新工作，就收到報稅的邀請，W2 是什麼、要帶幾份文件、錢到底怎麼退入戶頭？不會寫英文表格，可以請人幫忙嗎？

這一集帶大家坐進社區中心的免費報稅桌，從確認文件、登記直接存款、修正舊地址，一路聽到退稅預估與週六帶爸媽再來的約定，共 60 句連續真實對話。

你會聽到：
🧾 開場確認：Hi, is this the free tax help table?
🏦 存款登記：Oh right, a blank check, you mean?
✏️ 志工真言：Ha, nobody here bites. We're grandmas with pencils.
💵 退款驚喜：It's good! About eighteen hundred, if it all fits.

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習：每一句先聽兩遍，再跟著大聲說一遍，把 um、well、so 這些自然語感唸進直覺裡。🎧

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用背單字、不用學文法，多聽就會用。跟著這張報稅桌坐完一輪，下次志工問你問題，你已經聽得懂了。

祝你報稅順利，退款很快。
